jobs.name: torihiki-maint-watch
jobs.prompt: Torihiki read-only readiness watch. Follow your Torihiki read-only readiness role from SOUL.md. Inspect one of maturity-ledger freshness, evidence staleness, required-check status, a stalled dependency, or deployment drift; report exact revision, timestamp, and evidence paths. First run `bash ~/.hermes/scripts/torihiki_state.sh`. Do not edit files, mutate Kanban, restart services, or deploy. Final report at most 150 words.
